metas.name: Half Man
metas.description: Ruben turns up at his estranged brother Niall's wedding, acting as a catalyst for a revival of the last 40 years of their relationship. Available on HBO Max in 4K.

metas.name: The Testaments
metas.description: This sequel to "The Handmaid's Tale" follows Agnes and Daisy, two teens in Gilead who must navigate an elite preparatory school where obedience is brutally enforced. Their bond becomes the catalyst that will transform their lives. Available on Hulu in 4K.
